question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

Work in two steps. First, in the candidates field, brainstorm 20 candidate ideas, one line each, covering as wide a range as you can. Then select the 5 candidates that best combine being non-obvious with being feasible and informative, and develop those as your ideas.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation after priming
ideas.description: Prime cells with a stimulus, then rapidly degrade c-Fos or c-Jun using a dTAG or AID system and test whether the primed transcriptional response on a second stimulus is lost. If the memory survives degradation, AP-1 is not required to store it; if it disappears, AP-1 itself is the memory carrier.

ideas.title: Chromatin persistence time-course after washout
ideas.description: Run ATAC-seq and H3K27ac CUT&Tag at many time points after stimulus removal to measure how long AP-1-bound enhancers stay open and active. Pair this with CRISPR mutation of AP-1 motifs at those enhancers to test whether persistence depends on AP-1 binding.

ideas.title: Mitotic inheritance of AP-1 memory
ideas.description: Use live imaging of Fos/Jun reporters through mitosis, and sort daughter cells after division to measure whether AP-1 occupancy and enhancer accessibility are passed to them. Retention across division would support a mitotic bookmarking mechanism for memory.

ideas.title: Pulse-pattern encoding with optogenetic AP-1
ideas.description: Drive AP-1 activity with optogenetic pulses that vary in frequency, duration, and number, then measure how each pattern changes the response to a later test stimulus. This tests whether memory depends on the history of AP-1 dynamics rather than on a single active state.

ideas.title: Barcoded lineage tracing of past AP-1 activity
ideas.description: Label cells by their AP-1 activity history with a heritable reporter and barcode them, then profile the population later to see whether past AP-1 activity predicts present transcriptional state. This tests memory at the level of individual cells across time and division.

candidates: Degron-tag c-Fos or c-Jun (dTAG/AID) after priming and test whether the primed transcriptional response persists without AP-1

Vary the frequency and duration of optogenetic AP-1 pulses and measure how they change the response to a later stimulus
